name: Automatic renewal result
subject: [% IF checkout.auto_renew_error && !checkout.auto_renew_error.match('final$') %]Not renewed[% ELSE %]Renewed[% END %]: [% biblio.title | $Remove_MARC_punctuation | trim %]
about: Sent by the cron script misc/cronjobs/automatic_renewals.pl, one message per item, when the result changed since the last run. It goes to a patron who chose 'Auto renewal' in their messaging preferences (or to everyone by email, depending on the AutoRenewalNotices system preference). A patron who ticked 'Digests only' gets AUTO_RENEWALS_DGST instead.
